name: news-prospective-v1
phase_rule: First consecutive qualifying sessions, ordered by time; 5 full exchange sessions embargo between phases; same origin dates for all symbols and models; no random splits
qualifying_session: All five symbols have a successful uncapped request received in the six hours before or at official close; request belongs to a verified complete collection
news_selection: Latest observed URL/ticker version by cutoff; candidate only; publication within preceding 3 calendar days; identical headline deduplicated per ticker
price_features: Frozen compact stock+market+sector 11-feature definition from backend/compact_model.py; fit transforms only on fitting rows
fit_policy: Fit each ticker separately; fixed settings; validation diagnoses coverage/calibration without selecting parameters; refit on fit+validation matured rows once before assessment; no assessment refit
missing_news_policy: Zero numeric features and empty text; retain monitored quiet days in every comparison; missing collection is not no news
comparison: Combined versus both price_sector_only and historical_class_prior on matched ticker/origin pairs
assessment_reporting: Pooled and per-ticker primary Brier, three consecutive 21-origin blocks, news-present versus quiet-day subsets; paired 5-session moving-block bootstrap with all tickers kept together, 2000 replicates and seed 42
research_success_gate: Combined primary Brier lower than both comparators; paired 95 percent bootstrap interval for each loss difference entirely below zero; improvement versus price baseline in at least 3 of 5 tickers and 2 of 3 blocks; no production promotion on this experiment alone
scope: No public-trader features, trade execution, profitability claims or event causality labels. Secondary metrics are exploratory. Reserved 2026 outcome window remains unread.
